We are opening a fresh scientific cycle on roster-consistent latent exploration. Please act as an independent research innovator and stress-test the frozen object below before any result-bearing implementation is authorized. The purpose is to decide whether one public-state common plan carried through a physical membership event can have direct target-bound service value over a competent flexible learned controller that strictly contains the keep-plan policy class, or whether any surviving effect should be understood only as generic finite-budget regularization.

The new host is an 80-sector circular perimeter with four moving service beacons and 56 physical ticks. Beacons are separated by 20 sectors and advance one sector at every four-tick claim clock. Demand always sums to the current population and rotates deterministically across the four beacons. Training uses static rosters 4 and 8 plus within-episode 4-to-8 and 8-to-4 changes. Evaluation uses held-out static rosters 6 and 10 plus unseen 6-to-10 and 10-to-6 changes. Membership changes before the public claim at tick 20; survivors retain position, newcomers occupy unoccupied positions, departures are uniform, and there is no fixed roster slot or policy head. Every arm sees the same public roster, positions, beacon demands, time, event and newcomer pulses, public angular rank, and previous displacement. Every beacon claim is legal. A common deterministic decoder moves agents toward their claims and contains no latent or allocation choice.

The treatment, KEEP-COMMON, draws a four-dimensional continuous Normal plan once from the public episode-start set state, broadcasts it to all agents, and carries the same realization through churn to survivors and newcomers. FLEX-EVENT has the same manager and pointer-actor backbone but may add a learned public common update and an identity-free agent-specific noisy update at the event. Zeroing the two update-head outputs exactly recovers KEEP-COMMON on every legal history, so FLEX strictly contains the treatment. Both arms allocate the same maximum tensor inventory, share common initialization within a root, receive paired data and host randomness, make the same number of environment decisions and optimizer updates, use the same score-function objective and normalized whole-tensor SGD law, and expose only the block-256 checkpoint. The treatment hard-masks the event heads. This matches ordinary work but cannot match search geometry, gradient direction, zero-update incidence, curvature, or effective stochastic samples.

The cycle is deliberately gate-first. Before learning, a public minimum-distance coherent assignment scaffold is compared with an exogenously fragmented two-claim continuation to establish a physical opportunity, and with an independent-nearest policy to establish controllability. FLEX must then meet absolute recovery and integrated-unserved-demand ceilings and beat the same nearest policy on every held-out static and churn cell. Only after all opportunity, scaffold, and FLEX-competence gates pass can direct value be considered. The primary paired contrast is FLEX minus KEEP recovery time after churn, with companion integrated-unserved-demand nonharm. A KEEP win needs a simultaneous lower-bound advantage greater than two ticks on either churn direction, nonharm on the other direction, and nonharm on service loss in both directions. FLEX has a mirror rule; tight intervals inside one tick and 0.01 service loss define no material difference. A later check asks whether a KEEP win is at least 1.5 ticks larger under churn than at the matched static destination roster and whether treatment-blind claim fragmentation is lower by more than 0.03. There is no commonality-by-persistence factorial, so no separate commonality, persistence, or mediation claim is allowed.

Sixteen independent roots are prospectively paired. Scripted evaluation uses 512 episodes per root and held-out cell. Each learned arm/root receives exactly 256 updates of 32 complete episodes, balanced over the four training paths, followed by 512 held-out episodes per cell. All 52 registered one-sided tails share a Bonferroni Student-t familywise budget. The complete possible result has 425,984 episodes and 23,855,104 physical ticks. Execution, if scientifically necessary, is capped at four CPU workers and 90 wall minutes, with aggregate-only artifacts and no historical coordinate or lease input.

Please look for a genuinely answer-changing mechanism, counterexample, or smaller discriminator. In particular, determine whether the public host can create physical opportunity without smuggling in private information; whether the coherent scaffold and competence gates actually prevent an incompetent-comparator interpretation; whether strict containment makes a target-bound continuity claim impossible even when a finite-budget direct-value contrast is positive; whether the result map correctly distinguishes target-bound package value from generic regularization; and whether a static argument is already sufficient or the paired execution is scientifically necessary. Identify any concrete defect that would make the treatment/comparator, estimand, gate order, matched-work law, thresholds, or claim ceiling non-identifying. Preserve negative and null possibilities. Do not optimize for a favorable RCLE conclusion and do not import the preferred conclusion of any other direction.

The historical RCLE TBCFV material is evidence only and is not being reopened. If useful, you may inspect the public repository through the GitHub connector at https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code.git, exact origin-reachable commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81. Limit source inspection to the historical science card and the exact reference files under experiments/candidates/roster_consistent_latent_exploration_tbcfv named config.py, host_oracle.py, models.py, scripted.py, empirical_runner.py, and empirical_inference.py, plus test_models_and_scripted.py and test_empirical_runner.py. Treat those files only as scientific reference for containment, host semantics, and implementation feasibility. The new local Portfolio authority is not remotely reachable and must not be represented as such.

Return a conclusion-first scientific review: the strongest surviving candidate or counterexample, what direct observation would separate it from ordinary current-state control and generic finite-budget regularization, whether the proposed execution is necessary, the most serious validity risks, and the narrowest defensible claim under positive, negative, gate-failure, and unresolved outcomes. Do not provide workflow, permission, lease, or code-review conclusions.
